items.title: How Meta's Muse was a total game changer for the AI narrative
items.summary: Meta Platforms' (META) Muse chatbot not only moved AI stocks higher this week, but it may have even led to a tonal shift in the AI narrative and how consumers are using the new technology. Futurum CEO Daniel Newman weighs in on this topic.

items.title: Meta's Muse raises bigger question: Can consumers trust AI with our money?
items.summary: Meta's (META) Muse is the latest AI product that consumers have adopted to help in everyday purchases, raising the question yet again if people should be comfortable with sharing their financial information with a chatbot. Today's Market Hang panel consists of Host Turney Duff, Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi, tockBrokers.com director of investor research Jessica Inskip, and The Wealth Consulting Group chief market strategist Talley Léger.

items.title: AI magic sends markets higher, plus one-on-one with IBM vice chair
items.summary: Today on Sozzi Unleashed, we dive into the market's reaction to Meta's (META) Muse AI, Ray Dalio’s latest warning on a potential AI bubble, and Sozzi’s one-on-one conversation with IBM (IBM) Vice Chair and former US National Economic Council Director Gary Cohn.

items.title: Here are the stocks taking a hit amid the Muse hype
items.summary: The 8:30 Hosts Julie Hyman, Jake Conley, and Pras Subramanian look at the stocks taking a hit as Meta's (META) new AI agent, Muse, grows in popularity and why its hype may not measure up to its disruptive potential.

items.title: The AI panic, tech concentration, and Nvidia windfalls
items.summary: Gabelli Funds' John Belton and Wells Fargo Advisors' James Taylor break down the viral "doomer" warnings rippling through the AI industry, and why slowing down development might actually prevent a massive tech bubble.

items.title: Dow Jones Futures: Stocks Fall As Treasury Yields Soar; Palantir, Palo Alto Flash Buy Signals
items.summary: The stock market fell as Treasury yields skyrocketed and oil prices rose, but Palantir and Palo Alto flashed buy signals.

items.title: Meta Platforms (META) Gains As Market Dips: What You Should Know
items.summary: In the most recent trading session, Meta Platforms (META) closed at $744.1, indicating a +1.02% shift from the previous trading day.

items.title: Why Alphabet (GOOGL) Stock Is Down Today
items.summary: Shares of online advertising giant Alphabet (NASDAQ:GOOGL) fell 3.4% in the afternoon session after sentiment weakened ahead of rival Meta Platforms Connect conference, amid growing competitive pressure as peers Anthropic and OpenAI released cheaper frontier models.
